blocks.text: Alex Eala needed less than an hour to send off Thailand’s Patcharin Cheapchandej, 6-1, 6-0, from the Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan. The Filipina will next face Joanna Garland of Chinese Taipei in the quarterfinals. Garland, 25, is currently ranked 143rd in singles by the Women’s Tennis Association. This will be their first meeting. Garland also cruised into the quarterfinals, beating Mandegar Farzami of Iran, 6-1, 6-1. Eala had received a first-round bye and began her singles campaign in the second round. It was her second victory over Patcharin, whom she defeated, 6-3, 6-4, in an International Tennis Federation (ITF) event […]...
